description: 1-RC Equivalent Circuit Model with SOC-dependent parameters
source: Chen et al. (2020), J. Electrochem. Soc., 167, 080534

ocv_coefficients.description: OCV(SOC) = a0 + a1*SOC + a2*SOC^2 + a3*SOC^3 + a4*SOC^4 + a5*SOC^5
ocv_coefficients.source: Fitted to NMC811 OCV data from Chen et al. (2020)

soc_dependent_params.description: SOC-dependent multipliers for R0, R1, C1. Multiply nominal value by factor(SOC).
soc_dependent_params.note: factor(SOC) = b0 + b1*SOC + b2*SOC^2. Resistance increases at low/high SOC.
